text:
maria: @here Launch notice: Harbor-3 (model_id=harbor-3) is GA on Hosted API. Streaming v3 + tool-calling v3 are enabled. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/harbor-3 :tada:

maria: Example streaming request:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"harbor-3","input":"Translate to fr: The deployment succeeded","stream":true,"tool_call":true}'
```

dylan: Will we deprecate older streaming SDKs immediately?

maria: Old streaming SDK v1 will be deprecated in 90 days; migration guide published: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/stream-v1-to-v3

lee: Heads-up for Dedicated customers: pinning still supported via Console (Settings -> Models -> Pin) or API header `x-redwood-model: harbor-2@<version>` to lock variants.

deploy-bot: deploy: harbor-3-stream-v3 rolled to canary (eu-central-1) at 1813461150 — monitoring active.

support-sre: Created KB: "Harbor-3 GA — quick fixes" and added canned reply for support.

maria: Breaking change: `tool_input` renamed to `tool_args`. Tool outputs must follow stricter JSON schema; non-conforming output falls back to text. Strict validation available via `?validation=strict`.

dylan: Need limits for docs: default streaming concurrency + max tokens?

maria: Defaults: 200 concurrent streams/org, 65k tokens per stream. Support for limit increases via support tickets.

lee: We'll surface a customer-facing GA banner and per-tenant early-access toggle. Internal rollout dashboard: Console -> Deployments -> Harbor-3.

support-sre: Added on-call tag #harbor-3-ga and updated escalation playbook.

maria: Thanks — please report any anomalies. Post-GA sync at 15:30 PT. :rocket:
